dedupe_keys.name: digital hydroconnectivity of reservoirs and streamgages across the coterminous united states using ricon algorithm

description: Digital Hydroconnectivity of Reservoirs and Streamgages across the coterminous United States using RICON algorithm is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Mukhopadhyay, Sudarshana (deposited on HydroShare). This dataset presents the digital hydroconnectivity between streamgages and reservoirs as a concise edge list for the coterminous United States (CONUS) using the River and Infrastructure Connectivity Network (RICON) algorithm. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2022-01-21 and last updated 2022-01-24; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
